class.name: ResourceLoader
class.brief_description: A singleton for loading resource files.
class.description: A singleton used to load resource files from the filesystem. It uses the many [ResourceFormatLoader] classes registered in the engine (either built-in or from a plugin) to load files into memory and convert them to a format that can be used by the engine. [b]Note:[/b] You have to import the files into the engine first to load them using [method load]. If you want to load [Image]s at run-time, you may use [method Image.load]. If you want to import audio files, you can use the snippet described in [member AudioStreamMP3.data]. [b]Note:[/b] [code].gltf[/code], [code].glb[/code] and [code].fbx[/code] files that are not imported (for example in [code]user://[/code], or kept with the "Keep File" import mode) load as a [PackedScene] without an import step, using the [code]filesystem/scene_formats/*[/code] project settings. Imported files keep loading as imported scenes. [b]Note:[/b] Non-resource files such as plain text files cannot be read using [ResourceLoader]. Use [FileAccess] for those files instead, and be aware that non-resource files are not exported by default (see notes in the [FileAccess] class description for instructions on exporting them).

method.name: add_resource_format_loader
method.description: Registers a new [ResourceFormatLoader]. The ResourceLoader will use the ResourceFormatLoader as described in [method load]. This method is performed implicitly for ResourceFormatLoaders written in GDScript (see [ResourceFormatLoader] for more information).

method.name: exists
method.description: Returns whether a recognized resource exists for the given [param path]. An optional [param type_hint] can be used to further specify the [Resource] type that should be handled by the [ResourceFormatLoader]. Anything that inherits from [Resource] can be used as a type hint, for example [Image]. [b]Note:[/b] If you use [method Resource.take_over_path], this method will return [code]true[/code] for the taken path even if the resource wasn't saved (i.e. exists only in resource cache).

method.name: get_cached_count
method.description: Returns the number of resources in the resource cache of the [param kinds], without building an array of paths. Equal to the size of [method get_cached_paths] with the same [param kinds]. [codeblocks] [gdscript] print("Imported: ", ResourceLoader.get_cached_count(ResourceLoader.CACHED_RESOURCE_KIND_IMPORTED)) print("Own files: ", ResourceLoader.get_cached_count(ResourceLoader.CACHED_RESOURCE_KIND_FILE)) [/gdscript] [csharp] GD.Print("Imported: ", ResourceLoader.GetCachedCount(ResourceLoader.CachedResourceKind.Imported)); GD.Print("Own files: ", ResourceLoader.GetCachedCount(ResourceLoader.CachedResourceKind.File)); [/csharp] [/codeblocks]

method.name: get_cached_count_for_type
method.description: Returns the number of cached resources of [param type], like the size of [method get_cached_paths_for_type] with the same arguments, without building an array.

method.name: get_cached_count_in_directory
method.description: Returns the number of cached resources inside [param directory], like the size of [method get_cached_paths_in_directory] with the same arguments, without building an array.

method.name: get_cached_count_with_extension
method.description: Returns the number of cached resources with the file extension [param extension], like the size of [method get_cached_paths_with_extension] with the same arguments, without building an array.

method.name: get_cached_paths
method.description: Returns the paths of all resources that are currently in the resource cache, in no particular order. A resource stays in the cache as long as at least one reference to it exists. Each returned path can be passed to [method get_cached_ref] or [method has_cached]. The result includes the paths of built-in sub-resources that were cached together with their owner, such as [code]res://level.tscn::StyleBoxFlat_abc12[/code]. Resources without a path are never cached and are not included. To get only some of the paths, prefer [method get_cached_paths_for_type], [method get_cached_paths_with_extension] and [method get_cached_paths_in_directory], which filter in C++ and copy only the matching paths. Other filters can be applied in your script: [codeblocks] [gdscript] var textures = ResourceLoader.get_cached_paths().filter(func(path): return path.ends_with(".png")) [/gdscript] [csharp] var textures = ResourceLoader.GetCachedPaths().Where(path => path.EndsWith(".png")); [/csharp] [/codeblocks] [b]Note:[/b] The result is a snapshot. It is safe to call this method while other threads load resources, but those threads may add or remove paths right after it returns. [param kinds] limits the result to some kinds of resources, for example [code]CACHED_RESOURCE_KIND_FILE | CACHED_RESOURCE_KIND_BUILT_IN[/code] to leave out imported textures and sounds (see [enum CachedResourceKind]).

method.name: get_cached_paths_for_type
method.description: Returns the paths of the cached resources whose class is [param type] or inherits from it, in no particular order. [param type] can be a native class (including GDExtension classes) or a global script class ([code]class_name[/code] in GDScript, [code][GlobalClass][/code] in C#); a resource matches a script class if its script or one of its base scripts has that name. If [param exact_type] is [code]true[/code], only resources whose most derived named class is [param type] match: the first global class name found on the resource's script and its base scripts, otherwise its native class. A resource with a [code]class_name[/code] script therefore does not match its native base class exactly. An unknown class name returns an empty array. Like [method get_cached_paths], the result includes built-in sub-resources and is a snapshot that is safe to take while other threads load resources. [codeblocks] [gdscript] var textures = ResourceLoader.get_cached_paths_for_type(&"Texture2D") var only_curves = ResourceLoader.get_cached_paths_for_type(&"Curve", true) [/gdscript] [csharp] string[] textures = ResourceLoader.GetCachedPathsForType("Texture2D"); string[] onlyCurves = ResourceLoader.GetCachedPathsForType("Curve", true); [/csharp] [/codeblocks] [param kinds] limits the result to some kinds of resources, for example [code]CACHED_RESOURCE_KIND_FILE | CACHED_RESOURCE_KIND_BUILT_IN[/code] to leave out imported textures and sounds (see [enum CachedResourceKind]).

method.name: get_cached_paths_in_directory
get_cached_paths_with_extension
method.description: Returns the paths of the cached resources whose file has the extension [param extension], in no particular order. The extension is compared case-insensitively and may be given with or without a leading dot ([code]"tscn"[/code] or [code]".tscn"[/code]). Built-in sub-resources count as the extension of their file. An empty [param extension] returns the paths without an extension. [codeblocks] [gdscript] var scenes = ResourceLoader.get_cached_paths_with_extension("tscn") [/gdscript] [csharp] string[] scenes = ResourceLoader.GetCachedPathsWithExtension("tscn"); [/csharp] [/codeblocks] [param kinds] limits the result to some kinds of resources, for example [code]CACHED_RESOURCE_KIND_FILE | CACHED_RESOURCE_KIND_BUILT_IN[/code] to leave out imported textures and sounds (see [enum CachedResourceKind]).

method.name: get_cached_ref
method.description: Returns the cached resource reference for the given [param path]. [b]Note:[/b] If the resource is not cached, the returned [Resource] will be invalid.

method.name: get_cached_resources_for_type
method.description: Returns the cached resources of [param type] themselves, not their paths, in no particular order. The same filter as [method get_cached_paths_for_type]; [param kinds] limits the result to some kinds of resources, for example [code]CACHED_RESOURCE_KIND_FILE | CACHED_RESOURCE_KIND_BUILT_IN[/code] to leave out imported textures and sounds (see [enum CachedResourceKind]). Holding the returned array keeps the resources in the cache.

method.name: get_cached_type_counts
get_dependencies
get_manifest_paths
method.description: Returns all paths described by [param manifest]: the files in its [member FilesManifest.folder_paths] that match [member FilesManifest.extensions] and [member FilesManifest.type_hint], then its [member FilesManifest.file_paths], without duplicates. The paths are in their canonical form (see [method PathPrefixServer.resolve]); use them as keys for [method load_threaded_get_status] and [method load_threaded_get]. Folders are listed with [method list_directory], so imported files are returned by their original names and the result is the same in the editor and in exported projects. Missing folders and files print an error and are skipped; missing folders are created if [member FilesManifest.create_missing_folders] is [code]true[/code] and the folder is writable.

method.name: get_recognized_extensions_for_type
method.description: Returns the list of recognized extensions for a resource type.

method.name: get_resource_type
method.description: Returns the resource type associated with a given resource path. Only the loaders that may recognize the path are asked: those whose [method ResourceFormatLoader._get_recognized_extensions] contain the path's extension, and those that recognize paths in another way (for example by implementing [method ResourceFormatLoader._recognize_path], or by an [code].import[/code] file).

method.name: get_resource_uid
method.description: Returns the ID associated with a given resource path, or [code]-1[/code] when no such ID exists.

method.name: has_cached
method.description: Returns whether a cached resource is available for the given [param path]. Once a resource has been loaded by the engine, it is cached in memory for faster access, and future calls to the [method load] method will use the cached version. The cached resource can be overridden by using [method Resource.take_over_path] on a new resource for that same path.

method.name: has_extension_loader
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a load [Callable] is registered for [param extension] with [method register_extension_loader]. The extension is compared without the leading dot and case-insensitively.

method.name: list_directory
method.description: Lists a directory, returning all resources and subdirectories contained within. The resource files have the original file names as visible in the editor before exporting. The directories have [code]"/"[/code] appended. [codeblock] # Prints ["extra_data/", "model.gltf", "model.tscn", "model_slime.png"] print(ResourceLoader.list_directory("res://assets/enemies/slime")) [/codeblock] [b]Note:[/b] The order of files and directories returned by this method is not deterministic, and can vary between operating systems. [b]Note:[/b] To normally traverse the filesystem, see [DirAccess].

method.name: load
method.description: Loads a resource at the given [param path], caching the result for further access. The registered [ResourceFormatLoader]s are queried sequentially to find the first one which can handle the file's extension, and then attempt loading. If loading fails, the remaining ResourceFormatLoaders are also attempted. An optional [param type_hint] can be used to further specify the [Resource] type that should be handled by the [ResourceFormatLoader]. Anything that inherits from [Resource] can be used as a type hint, for example [Image]. The [param cache_mode] property defines whether and how the cache should be used or updated when loading the resource. In every cache mode, the returned resource has [member Resource.resource_path] set to the loaded path (localized to [code]res://[/code] when it is inside the project). With [constant CACHE_MODE_REUSE] it is the instance held by the cache for that path, so loading the same path again returns the same instance. With [constant CACHE_MODE_REPLACE] an already cached instance is updated in place and returned. With [constant CACHE_MODE_IGNORE] it is a separate instance that reports the path but is not cached. Returns an empty resource if no [ResourceFormatLoader] could handle the file, and prints an error if no file is found at the specified path. Use [method load_result] to get the [enum Error] code and the loader's message as well. GDScript has a simplified [method @GDScript.load] built-in method which can be used in most situations, leaving the use of [ResourceLoader] for more advanced scenarios. [b]Note:[/b] If [member ProjectSettings.editor/export/convert_text_resources_to_binary] is [code]true[/code], [method @GDScript.load] will not be able to read converted files in an exported project. If you rely on run-time loading of files present within the PCK, set [member ProjectSettings.editor/export/convert_text_resources_to_binary] to [code]false[/code]. [b]Note:[/b] Relative paths will be prefixed with [code]"res://"[/code] before loading, to avoid unexpected results make sure your paths are absolute.

method.name: load_manifest
load_result
load_threaded_get
method.description: Returns the resource loaded by [method load_threaded_request]. If this is called before the loading thread is done (i.e. [method load_threaded_get_status] is not [constant THREAD_LOAD_LOADED]), the calling thread will be blocked until the resource has finished loading. However, it's recommended to use [method load_threaded_get_status] to known when the load has actually completed.

method.name: load_threaded_get_manifest
method.description: Returns the loaded resources of [param manifest] as a [Dictionary] from path to [Resource]. Files are requested by [method load_threaded_request_manifest]; call this when the status is finished (a file that is still loading is waited for). Paths that failed to load are left out.

method.name: load_threaded_get_manifest_status
load_threaded_get_result
method.description: Returns the result of a load started with [method load_threaded_request], like [method load_threaded_get], but as a [ResourceLoadResult] with the [enum Error] code and the message the loader printed on its worker thread. Blocks like [method load_threaded_get] if the load is not finished yet. If no threaded load was requested for [param path], or its result was already collected, [member ResourceLoadResult.error] is [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER].

method.name: load_threaded_get_status
method.description: Returns the status of a threaded loading operation started with [method load_threaded_request] for the resource at [param path]. An array variable can optionally be passed via [param progress], and will return a one-element array containing the ratio of completion of the threaded loading (between [code]0.0[/code] and [code]1.0[/code]). [b]Note:[/b] The recommended way of using this method is to call it during different frames (e.g., in [method Node._process], instead of a loop).

method.name: load_threaded_request
method.description: Loads the resource using threads. If [param use_sub_threads] is [code]true[/code], multiple threads will be used to load the resource, which makes loading faster, but may affect the main thread (and thus cause game slowdowns). The [param cache_mode] parameter defines whether and how the cache should be used or updated when loading the resource.

method.name: load_threaded_request_manifest
load_threaded_step_manifest
method.description: Advances the load of [param manifest] (requested with [method load_threaded_request_manifest]) and returns its progress like [method load_threaded_get_manifest_status]. With threads it does nothing but return the progress, because the worker threads load. Without thread support (the default Web export) [method load_threaded_request_manifest] loads nothing and every call of this method loads one more file (a blocking step of one file), so the progress advances from frame to frame instead of freezing for the whole manifest. [method load_threaded_get_manifest] loads the files that are left. Call it every frame on all platforms.

method.name: rebuild_extension_index
method.description: Reads the recognized extensions of every registered [ResourceFormatLoader] again and rebuilds the index that finds loaders by the extension of a path. The list of a loader is read when it is added with [method add_resource_format_loader]. Call this method after a loader implemented in a script, in C# or in a GDExtension changes the list returned by [method ResourceFormatLoader._get_recognized_extensions], or after its script changed. Until then, paths with a newly added extension do not reach the loader. Removing and adding the loader again has the same effect. Loaders implemented in C++ do not need this: their lists are read again automatically when new resource classes register their extensions. [codeblocks] [gdscript] my_loader.extensions = PackedStringArray(["mydata"]) ResourceLoader.rebuild_extension_index() print(ResourceLoader.exists("res://level.mydata")) # Asks my_loader. [/gdscript] [csharp] myLoader.Extensions = ["mydata"]; ResourceLoader.RebuildExtensionIndex(); GD.Print(ResourceLoader.Exists("res://level.mydata")); // Asks myLoader. [/csharp] [/codeblocks]

method.name: register_extension_loader
remove_resource_format_loader
method.description: Unregisters the given [ResourceFormatLoader].

method.name: set_abort_on_missing_resources
method.description: Changes the behavior on missing sub-resources. The default behavior is to abort loading.

method.name: unregister_extension_loader
method.description: Removes the format registered for [param extension] with [method register_extension_loader]. Loading such a file afterwards fails with the usual error for files that no loader recognizes, unless another loader takes the extension. Returns [constant OK], or [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] if no load [Callable] is registered for [param extension].

constants.constant: The resource is invalid, or has not been loaded with [method load_threaded_request].
The resource is still being loaded.
Some error occurred during loading and it failed.
The resource was loaded successfully and can be accessed via [method load_threaded_get].
Resources saved in their own file and not imported, such as [code].tres[/code], [code].tscn[/code] and [code].res[/code] files.
Resources loaded through an importer, such as textures, sounds and fonts ([member Resource.resource_path] is the source file, for example [code]res://icon.svg[/code]).
Built-in sub-resources that were cached with their owner, such as [code]res://level.tscn::StyleBoxFlat_abc12[/code].

Neither the main resource (the one requested to be loaded) nor any of its subresources are retrieved from cache nor stored into it. Dependencies (external resources) are loaded with [constant CACHE_MODE_REUSE].

The main resource (the one requested to be loaded), its subresources, and its dependencies (external resources) are retrieved from cache if present, instead of loaded. Those not cached are loaded and then stored into the cache. The same rules are propagated recursively down the tree of dependencies (external resources).

Like [constant CACHE_MODE_REUSE], but the cache is checked for the main resource (the one requested to be loaded) as well as for each of its subresources. Those already in the cache, as long as the loaded and cached types match, have their data refreshed from storage into the already existing instances. Otherwise, they are recreated as completely new objects.
Like [constant CACHE_MODE_IGNORE], but propagated recursively down the tree of dependencies (external resources).
Like [constant CACHE_MODE_REPLACE], but propagated recursively down the tree of dependencies (external resources).
